title: Agent token efficiency
description: Reporting-only Claude Code and Codex dashboard built from verified signal catalogues in issues #471 and #472.

panels.title: Estimated cost by session and model

targets.expr: sum by (session_id, model) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{session_id=~"$session"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tokens by session, model, and type

targets.expr: sum by (session_id, model, type) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{session_id=~"$session"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Input, output, cache-read, and cache-creation tokens per request

targets.expr: sum by (type) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format type="input" | unwrap input_tokens [$__interval]))
sum by (type) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format type="output" | unwrap output_tokens [$__interval]))
sum by (type) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format type="cache-read" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__interval]))
sum by (type) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format type="cache-creation" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__interval]))

panels.title: API request round trips by session

targets.expr: sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" [${__interval}]))

panels.title: Context tokens per API request (p50, p95, max)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format context_tokens="{{ add .input_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_creation_tokens }}" | unwrap context_tokens [$__interval]) by (session_id)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format context_tokens="{{ add .input_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_creation_tokens }}" | unwrap context_tokens [$__interval]) by (session_id)

max_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format context_tokens="{{ add .input_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_creation_tokens }}" | unwrap context_tokens [$__interval]) by (session_id)
sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session" | query_source="compact" [$__interval]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"$session" [$__interval]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | success="false" | session_id=~"$session" [$__interval]))
avg by (tool_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__interval]))
sum by (type) (increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{session_id=~"$session"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tool result size by tool
panels.description: The p95 series uses the right axis so it remains readable next to total bytes.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap tool_result_size_bytes [$__interval]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap tool_result_size_bytes [$__interval]) by (tool_name)

panels.title: Estimated cost by model, source, and effort

targets.expr: sum by (model, query_source, effort) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{session_id=~"$session"}[$__rate_interval]))

options.content: Main/subagent attribution uses the observed `query_source` attribute. `agent_id` and `skill_name` were not observed and remain unavailable rather than being displayed as zero.

panels.title: Codex tokens by model and type
panels.description: Unavailable Codex samples remain unavailable and are never rendered as zero.

targets.expr: sum by (model, token_type, originator, session_source) (increase(codex_turn_token_usage_sum[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Codex tool calls by model and source
panels.description: Native metrics expose aggregate tool-call volume, not tool names or success; unavailable samples remain unavailable.

targets.expr: sum by (model, originator, session_source) (increase(codex_turn_tool_call_sum[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average Codex turn duration
panels.description: Average completed-turn duration from the captured histogram; unavailable samples remain unavailable.

targets.expr: sum by (model, originator, session_source) (rate(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (model, originator, session_source) (rate(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_count[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Codex attribution boundary
panels.description: Unavailable issue and branch dimensions remain visible instead of being inferred.

options.content: Issue/branch attribution is unavailable in native Codex metrics. Compare source totals here; do not claim a planner + implementer total for one GitHub issue.
